releaseByUse(uint256,bytes32).details: Audit round 3 (H-1, H-2, M-1). Anyone may call this at any moment, so it buys only at a price nobody can      set for the call: the coin's price must be steady as a fetch's buy needs it (`ICoinFetch.steadyPrice`: within      the drift of the window's mean and of the settled price), else it reverts `Unsteady` and is tried later. A      coin younger than a window has no mean, so no release runs inside its snipe window. A share that use earned      is never the poster's while its entry's coin can still take it: what a call doesn't fill stays the entry's      (`shareLeftOf`) and a later call fills more, and a call that fills nothing reverts `NothingFills`.

LISTER_SHARE_BPS().notice: `route_coin.bounty_lister_share`, bps of the coins a release buys that go to the credited contributor.

QUOTE_GAS().notice: The gas one of the pool's quotes gets in `settle`: several times what a quote through UNB's v4 pool takes         across real liquidity. A quote that needs more is a pool that can't answer (`_capValue`).

SETTLEMENT().notice: The deployment these bounties are wired to, which Settlement's constructor checks.

USE_CAP_BPS().notice: `route_coin.bounty_use_cap`, bps of a counting line's USDC it may release (`decide.bounty-cap-five`).

coinAtSettle(uint256,bytes32).notice: Whether bounty `id` is settled and `entryId`'s coin had launched when it was: only then does a release by         use buy for the entry; otherwise the entry's share is the poster's.

confirm(uint256,bytes32,uint256,uint256).notice: `coin.bounty-confirm`: the poster releases bounty `id` to `entryId` once its own paid call on it has         been claimed as a counting line after posting, once the entry's coin trades (reverts `NoCoin` before: a         confirmation never launches a coin) and is past its snipe window (reverts `Unsteady` inside it). Buys at market up to the limit, at once         (`coin.bounty-no-slicing`); `route_coin.bounty_lister_share` of the coins is staked for the credited         contributor and the rest for the poster. What does not fill is the poster's to take back. `deadline`         bounds when the buy may run (CL-03); the limit is its least. `maxCost` is the most this confirmation pays         a coin, its average price fees and tax included, scaled by 1e18 as the limit is: above it the confirmation         reverts `CostAboveMax` and moves nothing, so a price pushed ahead of it in its block can't fill it. The node         sends the curve's quote with its trade slippage.

lastCounted(bytes32,address).notice: When a wallet's latest counting line on an entry was claimed, while a bounty for its site was open.

onCountingLine(bytes32,address,uint256).notice: `coin.bounty-by-use`, R4.33: Settlement reports a counting line on `entryId`, paid by `payer`, of `usdc`.         Only lines whose payer is another identity than the entry's contributor (`controllerOf`) count.

post(bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint64).notice: `coin.bounty-launch`, `coin.bounty-limit`: posts `amount` of the caller's UNB for `site`.

refund(uint256).notice: The poster takes back what is its own: what a confirmation did not fill, and after settlement what         nobody's use reserved (pull).

releaseByUse(uint256,bytes32).notice: `coin.bounty-by-use`: after `settle`, anyone releases `entryId`'s share of bounty `id`, in proportion to         the USDC its counting lines paid while the bounty was open. It buys only at a steady price         (`ICoinFetch.steadyPrice`), else reverts and is tried later. What a call does not fill at the limit stays         the entry's, for a later call. A share is the poster's when its entry left the site, lost its         contributor or has no coin: a release never launches one.

settle(uint256).notice: After the deadline anyone fixes what an unconfirmed bounty releases by use: at most         `route_coin.bounty_use_cap` of the USDC its site's counting lines paid, in UNB at the lower of the pool's         steady quote and its mean (`IUnbPoolMean`), and never more than the bounty. The rest becomes the poster's to         take back.

shareLeftOf(uint256,bytes32).notice: What is left of an entry's share by use after its releases so far: the entry's, filled by a later         release, never the poster's (audit round 3 H-2).

useOf(uint256,bytes32).notice: The USDC counting lines on `entryId` paid while bounty `id` was open, counted for the bounty's site, as its         release by use reads them.
